facts.fact: 他当面说了结束——至少没玩消失；谎言的内疚啃着她。
facts.anchor: At least he had the nerve to say it to my face, rather than ghosting me. The guilt of my lies gnaws at me

facts.fact: 她向 Reston 坦白：爱上已婚男和他的妻子。
facts.anchor: I fell for a guy. Turned out he was married… and I fell for his wife, too.

facts.fact: 三人关系八个月——某天对方不再接电话。
facts.anchor: We spent eight months together. Three of us. And one day they stopped answering the phone.

facts.fact: Reston 惊呼欠 Harriet 五十块赌注。
facts.anchor: “God damnit. I owe Harriet fifty bucks.”

facts.fact: 「人人都知道」：她爸和 Miss Celia 两年前就押注他会追去纽约。
facts.anchor: Of course I know, Ashey. Everyone knows. Your dad and Miss Celia both had bets on him chasin’ you to the city two years ago.

facts.fact: Ev/Jody 不是没察觉——只是自欺不愿看见他多迷你。
facts.anchor: They ain’t dumb, Ash. They know you. They know Brooks. They tellin’ themselves a fat old lie if they ain’t noticed how gone for you he is.

facts.fact: 明晚航班回纽约——all out of time。
facts.anchor: I ain’t got time, Reston. I got a flight back to New York tomorrow night. I’m all out of time.

facts.fact: 偏头痛救援：Ev 把卡车开进小径、Jody 把她安置到后座、Ruth 握手安抚。
facts.anchor: Somehow, Everett has managed to navigate his truck down this narrow, barely-worn track, and Jody tucks my arms and legs against my body as he carefully lays me on the back seat.

relations: Reston 视她为大姐、要搭下一班航班回来护她
Ev 是 Brooks 挚友、她妈妈雇着 Brooks 全家、几乎亲手带大他
Harriet 是最接近姐姐的人（她犹豫要不要打）
Ruth 在后座握住她的手说你们都安全
